fixed_profile.name: runtime
fixed_profile.program: one literal object + one EMIT_OBJECT; no portfolio search
fixed_profile.rationale: the field's observations are derived by re-scanning the materialized source, not from the winning program, so a single exact, deterministic program preserves the surface without searching

per_document.columns: id fmt size_class src_B cur_ms dir_ms speedup cur_rss_kb dir_rss_kb cur_auth_B dir_auth_B

known_difference.why: this projection embeds the chosen reconstruction program's shape (descriptor object count and program op count). A fixed program reports its own (RAW: 1/1); the searched winner reports its winner's.
known_difference.packages: no difference: DOCX/EPUB common metadata is format-model derived (encoder-independent); the searched winner for a ZIP also has 1 object / 1 op

files.raw/build.tsv: per-document wall ms + peak RSS (GNU time -v) + authority bytes + speedup
files.raw/exact.tsv: per-document exactness: current field, direct field, direct authority (length + SHA-256 + cmp)
files.raw/observe.tsv: per-document observation equality over the 11-entry schedule (raw rc + normalized equality + note)
files.raw/subset.tsv: the fixed subset resolved from the manifest (id|agency|fmt|size_class|byte_len|sha256|path)

caveats: Wall times are single-run per step (no repetition); the direct path's cost is dominated by materializing/rescanning the source, so the speedup shrinks as formats get less compressible. Exactness and observation equality are exact byte comparisons, not estimates. The field-build CLI writes the exact authority to --voldoc by reading it back from the store once (only when --voldoc is requested).
